products.name: ACK1 / スーパーリターダー
products.desc: アンカーセメントミルク注入用遅延型分散剤。分散性と低ブリージングの両立を実現し、長時間流動性を保持します。
products.problem: 未添加の場合、時間の経過と共に流動性が低下し、圧送負荷の増大や充填不良のリスクがあります。
products.wow: 長時間流動保持 & 低添加量
products.usage: グラウンドアンカー、急傾斜地対策

products.name: OPフローシリーズ (OP1/OP2)
products.desc: OPTジェット工法用混和剤。通常型(S)と液状化対策用揺変性型(L)の2種。排泥量を抑制します。
products.problem: 汎用品ではスラリー量が増大し、産廃処分費の高騰や地盤変位を招く恐れがあります。
products.wow: 清水建設・ライト工業共同開発
products.usage: 薬液注入工、ジェットグラウト工

products.name: RAD剤 (セメント急結材)
products.desc: アンカー・ロックボルト用注入材の可塑状団結を促進。亀裂性の高い地盤でも逸失を防ぎます。
products.problem: 亀裂の多い地盤では注入材がどこまでも流出してしまい、定着不良や材料費の浪費に繋がります。
products.wow: 崩壊性地盤での確実な注入
products.usage: グラウンドアンカー、急傾斜地対策

products.name: S-chem (粘性土用混和剤)
products.desc: 地盤改良、ジェットグラウト、DSM向け。難改良土である粘性土の混合性を高め、強度発現を改善します。
products.problem: 粘性土（粘土）はセメントと混ざりにくく、改良体に未混合部分（ダマ）ができ強度が不足します。
products.wow: 粘性土の混合性・強度改善
products.usage: 地盤改良、ジェットグラウト、DSM

products.name: ベントナイト (DK-BENTONITE)
products.desc: 場所打ち杭やシールド作泥土に不可欠な高品質天然粘土鉱物。API規格準拠品もあり。
products.problem: 低品質な安定液では掘削壁が崩壊し、工事の中断や埋め戻し事故が発生するリスクがあります。
products.wow: 安定した造壁性とコスト
products.usage: 場所打ち杭、シールド作泥土

products.name: Deep25 (ディープ25)
products.desc: 粘性土掘削助剤。粘土の抱きつき（供回り）を防ぎ、ダマを解消して改良体の強度を飛躍的に高めます。
products.problem: 粘土がヘッドに抱きつき（供回り）、削孔停止や最悪の場合はヘッド脱落（損失）事故を引き起こします。
products.wow: ダマ解消 & 強度向上

products.name: DK-バックフィル (裏込め材)
products.desc: シールド用可塑性グラウト。圧送時は低粘性、注入後は即ゲル化。可使時間を秒単位でコントロール。
products.problem: 長距離圧送中に配管が閉塞（パンク）したり、充填不足による地盤沈下事故が起きるリスクがあります。
products.wow: 配管閉塞ゼロ & 即時ゲル化
products.pkg: ローリー / プラント
products.usage: シールド裏込め、空洞充填

products.name: DK-アクアヴィスコ (水中不分離)
products.desc: 強力な粘性を付与する水中不分離性混和剤。汚濁防止膜なしでも材料分離を防ぎます。
products.problem: 水中打設時にセメントが流出し、強度が発現しないだけでなく、深刻な海洋汚染を引き起こします。
products.wow: 強力な増粘 & 海洋汚染防止
products.usage: 水中コンクリート、海上ポンプ圧送

products.name: DK-リペアモルタル (断面修復)
products.desc: 厚塗りしてもダレない高強度補修モルタル。天井面や垂直面でもボタ落ちしません。
products.problem: 一般モルタルでは天井面から剥がれ落ち、施工効率が悪化するうえ、早期にひび割れが再発します。
products.wow: 天井でも落ちない保形性
products.dosage: そのまま使用 (プレミックス)

en.hero_title: The Answer lies in the Soil.

en.mode_field_desc: Find solutions based on site challenges

ground.title: 1. Ground Improvement
ground.desc: Custom solidification agents for any soil type.

shield.title: 2. Shield & Tunnel (TBM)
shield.desc: Chemical solutions to maximize TBM performance.

repair.title: 4. Repair & Maintenance
repair.desc: Shotcrete and repair mortars for infrastructure longevity.

concrete.title: 5. Concrete & General
concrete.desc: Admixtures and grouts for fundamental civil engineering.

products.name: ACK1 / Super Retarder
products.desc: Retarding dispersant for anchor cement milk. Balances dispersion & low bleeding.
products.problem: Without it, fluidity decreases over time, risking pump blockage and incomplete filling.

products.name: OP Flow Series
products.desc: Admixture for OPT Jet Method. Reduces sludge and displacement.
products.problem: Standard mixtures produce excessive sludge, increasing disposal costs and ground displacement risks.

products.name: RAD Agent (Accelerator)
products.desc: Promotes plastic consolidation for anchor grouting. Prevents loss in cracked ground.
products.problem: In fractured ground, grout flows away endlessly, causing anchoring failure and material waste.

products.name: S-chem (For Clay)
products.desc: Special admixture for cohesive soil improvement. Improves mixing efficiency and strength.
products.problem: Clay soils clump together and resist mixing with cement, leading to weak spots and failure.

products.name: DK-BENTONITE
products.desc: High-quality natural clay for slurry walls and shield tunneling. API standard available.
products.problem: Poor quality slurry leads to trench wall collapse and catastrophic site accidents.

products.name: Deep25
products.desc: Anti-clogging additive for viscous soil. Dissolves lumps to ensure full mixing and strength.
products.problem: Clay clogging (co-rotation) causes machine stoppage and risks head loss (tool detachment).

products.name: DK-BACKFILL Grout
products.desc: Plasticity grout for TBM backfilling. Pumps easily, gels instantly.
products.problem: Risk of pipe blockage during pumping and ground settlement due to incomplete filling.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO
products.desc: Anti-washout admixture. Prevents segregation underwater.
products.problem: Concrete separates underwater, losing strength and causing severe marine pollution.

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: High-strength non-sag mortar. Stays on ceilings without dripping.
products.problem: Ordinary mortar drips from overhead surfaces and cracks easily after curing.

cta.title: Don't give up on your soil.

products.name: ACK1 / Super Retardante
products.desc: Dispersante retardante para lechada de anclaje. Mantiene la fluidez por largo tiempo.
products.problem: Sin él, la fluidez disminuye, arriesgando el bloqueo de la bomba.

products.name: OP Flow Series
products.desc: Aditivo para Jet Grouting. Reduce lodos y desplazamiento del suelo.
products.problem: El exceso de lodo aumenta los costos de eliminación y el riesgo de desplazamiento.

products.name: RAD Agent (Acelerante)
products.desc: Promueve la consolidación plástica en anclajes. Previene pérdidas en suelos fracturados.
products.problem: En suelo fracturado, la lechada se pierde, causando fallas en el anclaje.

products.name: S-chem (Para Arcilla)
products.desc: Aditivo especial para mejorar la mezcla en suelos cohesivos (arcilla).
products.problem: La arcilla no se mezcla bien con el cemento, creando puntos débiles.

products.name: DK-BENTONITE
products.desc: Bentonita de alta calidad para muros pantalla. Norma API disponible.
products.problem: El lodo de mala calidad provoca el colapso de las paredes de la zanja.

products.name: Deep25
products.desc: Aditivo anti-atasco para suelos viscosos. Disuelve grumos para mayor resistencia.
products.problem: La arcilla se pega al cabezal, deteniendo la perforación y arriesgando la pérdida de la herramienta.

products.name: DK-BACKFILL Grout
products.desc: Mortero plástico para relleno de TBM. Bombea fácil, gelifica al instante.
products.problem: Riesgo de bloqueo de tuberías y asentamiento del terreno.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO
products.desc: Aditivo anti-lavado. Previene la segregación bajo el agua.
products.problem: El hormigón se separa bajo el agua, perdiendo fuerza y contaminando.

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: Mortero de reparación de alta resistencia. No se descuelga en techos.
products.problem: El mortero común gotea y se agrieta fácilmente.

products.name: ACK1 / Super Retardateur
products.desc: Dispersant retardateur pour coulis d'ancrage. Maintient la fluidité longtemps.

products.name: OP Flow Series
products.desc: Adjuvant pour Jet Grouting. Réduit les boues et le déplacement.
products.problem: L'excès de boue augmente les coûts d'élimination et les risques de déplacement.

products.name: RAD Agent (Accélérateur)
products.desc: Favorise la consolidation plastique pour l'ancrage.

products.name: S-chem (Pour Argile)

products.name: DK-BENTONITE

products.name: Deep25
products.desc: Adjuvant anti-colmatage pour sol visqueux. Dissout les grumeaux pour augmenter la résistance.

products.name: DK-BACKFILL Grout
products.desc: Coulis plastique pour remplissage TBM. Gélifie instantanément.
products.problem: Risque de blocage des tuyaux et de tassement du sol.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: Mortier de réparation haute résistance. Ne coule pas au plafond.
products.problem: Le mortier ordinaire coule et se fissure facilement.

ground.title: 1. 地基处理/锚索
ground.desc: “没有固化不了的土”。应对粘性土及陡坡治理。

shield.title: 2. 盾构/隧道

products.name: ACK1 / 超级缓凝剂
products.desc: 锚索水泥浆用缓凝分散剂。长时间保持流动性。
products.problem: 不使用时流动性下降，面临泵管堵塞和填充不完全的风险。

products.name: OP Flow系列 (OP1/OP2)
products.desc: OPT旋喷工法用外加剂。减少排泥量及周边位移。
products.problem: 普通泥浆排泥量大，增加处理成本并可能导致地层位移。
products.wow: 清水建设・Raito工业共同开发

products.name: RAD剂 (速凝剂)
products.desc: 促进锚索注浆材料的塑性固结。防止在裂隙地层中流失。
products.problem: 在破碎地层中，浆液会无限制流失，导致锚固失效和材料浪费。
products.wow: 破碎地层中的可靠注浆

products.name: S-chem (粘性土专用)
products.desc: 专为地基处理、旋喷、DSM开发。改善难改良粘性土的混合性。
products.problem: 粘性土难以与水泥混合，导致搅拌不均，强度不足。

products.name: 膨润土 (DK-BENTONITE)
products.desc: 灌注桩及盾构泥浆必不可少的高品质天然粘土。符合API标准。
products.problem: 劣质泥浆会导致槽壁坍塌，引发工程事故。

products.name: Deep25 (深层25)
products.desc: 粘性土掘削助剂。消除泥团以确保混合均匀，从而显著提高强度。
products.problem: 粘土“抱钻”会导致钻孔停止，严重时发生钻头脱落（丢失）事故。
products.wow: 消除泥团 & 提高强度

products.name: DK-BACKFILL (壁后注浆)
products.desc: 盾构壁后注浆用塑性浆液。注入后瞬间胶凝。
products.problem: 长距离输送易堵管，或因填充不足导致地面沉降。

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO (水下不分散)
products.desc: 赋予混凝土强粘性，水中不分散。
products.problem: 水下浇筑时水泥流失，强度下降并造成严重海洋污染。
products.wow: 强增粘 & 防止海洋污染

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR (修复砂浆)

products.problem: 普通砂浆在天花板面易滴落，且固化后易开裂。

products.name: S-chem (점성토용)
products.desc: 난개량 토질인 점성토의 혼합성 및 강도 개선.
products.problem: 점성토는 시멘트와 잘 섞이지 않아 개량체 강도 부족 초래.

products.name: DK-BENTONITE
products.desc: 현장타설말뚝 및 쉴드 이수용 고품질 벤토나이트. API 규격 준수.
products.problem: 저품질 이수는 굴착벽 붕괴 및 공사 사고를 유발.

products.name: Deep25 (딥25)
products.desc: 점성토 굴착 보조제. 점토의 '공회전'을 방지하고 덩어리를 해소하여 강도를 비약적으로 향상.
products.problem: 점토가 헤드에 달라붙어 굴착이 멈추거나 최악의 경우 헤드가 유실되는 사고 위험.

products.name: DK-BACKFILL (뒷채움재)
products.desc: 쉴드 뒷채움용 가소성 그라우트. 주입 후 즉시 겔화.
products.problem: 장거리 압송 중 배관 막힘이나 충전 부족으로 인한 지반 침하 위험.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO (수중불분리)
products.desc: 수중에서도 재료 분리를 방지. 오탁방지막 불필요 수준.
products.problem: 수중 타설 시 시멘트가 유실되어 강도 저하 및 심각한 해양 오염 발생.

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: 두껍게 발라도 처지지 않는 고강도 보수 몰탈.
products.problem: 일반 몰탈은 천장에서 떨어지거나 쉽게 균열이 발생.

it.hero_desc: Non accontentarti dei prodotti a catalogo. Formuliamo la ricetta perfetta per il tuo cantiere.

ground.title: 1. Miglioramento del Terreno
ground.desc: Soluzioni per terreni coesivi e ancoraggi.

products.name: ACK1 / Super Ritardante
products.desc: Disperdente ritardante per ancoraggi. Mantiene la fluidità a lungo.
products.problem: Senza, la fluidità diminuisce, rischiando blocchi della pompa.

products.name: OP Flow Series
products.desc: Additivo per Jet Grouting. Riduce i fanghi.
products.problem: L'eccesso di fango aumenta i costi di smaltimento e i rischi.

products.name: RAD (Accelerante)
products.desc: Promuove il consolidamento plastico negli ancoraggi.
products.problem: In terreni fratturati, la malta si perde, causando il fallimento dell'ancoraggio.

products.name: S-chem (Per Argilla)
products.desc: Additivo speciale per terreni coesivi. Migliora miscelazione.
products.problem: L'argilla non si mescola bien col cemento, creando punti deboli.

products.name: DK-BENTONITE
products.desc: Bentonite di alta qualità per diaframmi. Standard API.
products.problem: Fanghi di scarsa qualità causano il crollo delle pareti dello scavo.

products.name: Deep25
products.desc: Additivo anti-intasamento per terreni viscosi. Dissolve i grumi aumentando la resistenza.
products.problem: L'intasamento da argilla blocca la perforazione e rischia la perdita dell'utensile.

products.name: DK-BACKFILL Grout
products.desc: Malta plastica per TBM. Gelifica istantaneamente.
products.problem: Rischio di blocco tubi e cedimento del terreno.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO
products.desc: Anti-dilavamento. Previene segregazione sott'acqua.
products.problem: Il calcestruzzo si separa sott'acqua, perdendo forza e inquinando.

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: Malta riparante ad alta resistenza. Non cola dai soffitti.
products.problem: La malta comune cola e si crepa facilmente.

cta.title: Non arrenderti con il tuo terreno.

pl.hero_desc: Nie zadowalaj się produktami katalogowymi. Opracujemy idealną recepturę dla Twojej budowy.

ground.title: 1. Wzmocnienie Gruntu
ground.desc: Rozwiązania dla gruntów spoistych i kotew.

products.name: ACK1 / Super Opóźniacz
products.desc: Opóźniacz do zaczynów kotwiących. Utrzymuje płynność.
products.problem: Bez niego płynność spada, grożąc zatorami pompy.

products.name: OP Flow Series
products.desc: Domieszka do Jet Grouting. Redukuje szlam.
products.problem: Nadmiar szlamu zwiększa koszty utylizacji i ryzyko przemieszczeń.

products.name: RAD (Przyspieszacz)
products.desc: Przyspiesza konsolidację plastyczną w kotwach.
products.problem: W spękanym gruncie zaczyn ucieka, powodując awarię kotwienia.

products.name: S-chem (Do Gliny)
products.desc: Specjalna domieszka do gruntów spoistych.
products.problem: Glina nie miesza się dobrze z cementem, tworząc słabe punkty.

products.name: DK-BENTONITE
products.desc: Wysokiej jakości bentonit do ścian szczelinowych. Standard API.
products.problem: Słaba zawiesina prowadzi do zawalenia ścian wykopu.

products.name: Deep25
products.desc: Dodatek przeciwko oblepianiu w gruntach spoistych. Rozpuszcza grudki, zwiększając wytrzymałość.
products.problem: Oblepianie głowicy gliną zatrzymuje wiercenie i grozi utratą narzędzia.

products.name: DK-BACKFILL Grout
products.desc: Plastyczna zaprawa do TBM. Żeluje natychmiast.
products.problem: Ryzyko zatoru rur i osiadania gruntu.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO
products.desc: Anty-wymywająca. Zapobiega segregacji pod wodą.
products.problem: Beton segreguje się pod wodą, tracąc wytrzymałość i zanieczyszczając.

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: Wysokowytrzymała zaprawa naprawcza. Nie spływa z sufitów.
products.problem: Zwykła zaprawa kapie i łatwo pęka.

ground.title: 1. Cải tạo đất
ground.desc: Giải pháp cho đất dính và neo đất.

products.desc: Phụ gia phân tán chậm đông cho vữa neo. Duy trì độ chảy lâu dài.
products.problem: Nếu không dùng, độ chảy giảm, gây tắc bơm và lấp đầy không hoàn toàn.

products.name: OP Flow Series
products.desc: Phụ gia cho Jet Grouting. Giảm bùn thải.
products.problem: Quá nhiều bùn thải làm tăng chi phí xử lý và nguy cơ dịch chuyển đất.

products.name: RAD (Đông cứng nhanh)
products.desc: Thúc đẩy cố kết dẻo trong neo đất. Ngăn ngừa mất vữa.
products.problem: Trong đất nứt nẻ, vữa chảy mất, gây thất bại neo.
products.wow: Bơm vữa an toàn trong đất nứt

products.name: S-chem (Cho Đất Sét)
products.desc: Phụ gia đặc biệt cho đất dính. Cải thiện trộn.
products.problem: Đất sét không trộn đều với xi măng, tạo ra điểm yếu.

products.name: DK-BENTONITE
products.desc: Bentonite chất lượng cao cho tường vây. Có tiêu chuẩn API.
products.problem: Dung dịch kém chất lượng dẫn đến sập vách hố đào.

products.name: Deep25
products.desc: Phụ gia chống dính cho đất sét. Làm tan cục đất để tăng cường độ.
products.problem: Đất sét dính vào đầu khoan gây dừng máy và nguy cơ mất dụng cụ khoan.
products.wow: Tan cục đất & Tăng cường độ

products.name: DK-BACKFILL Grout
products.desc: Vữa dẻo lấp đầy vỏ hầm TBM. Đông ngay lập tức.
products.problem: Nguy cơ tắc ống bơm và sụt lún mặt đất.

products.name: DK-AQUA VISCO
products.desc: Chống phân tầng dưới nước. Ngăn ngừa tách lớp.
products.problem: Bê tông tách lớp dưới nước, mất cường độ và gây ô nhiễm.

products.name: DK-REPAIR MORTAR
products.desc: Vữa sửa chữa cường độ cao. Không chảy xệ trên trần.
products.problem: Vữa thường chảy xệ và dễ nứt.
